title: Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Marketing Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline for our products. This role blends strategy with hands-on execution, from crafting compelling campaigns and driving demand generation, to collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, SDRs, Product, Communications, and Alliances.

As a key contributor to our marketing team, you'll take ownership of high-impact programs including integrated campaigns, product launches, events, and account-based marketing. You'll play a pivotal role in connecting our products with the right audiences whether enterprise customers, developers, or strategic partners. You thrive in fast-paced environments, love experimenting and optimizing based on data. You are passionate about technology, marketing and the use of technology in marketing. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to make things better for your campaigns, your team, and your own growth. If you enjoy building smart, scalable marketing engines with a bit of creative flair, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Remote, EMEA

What your day will look like

  • Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data-driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals. You will work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data. Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS, but you will not need certifications. You\'ll have used these environments a bit. You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a diverse group united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products and services play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are remote-first and committed to inclusivity and growth.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security , Identity & Access Management , and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity:

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves):

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains:

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, eager to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via shared equity.
  • Remote work flexibility: work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose and removes barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer; we value inclusivity and diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team regarding accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is global and remote-first, with members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Head of Lifecycle Marketing
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The Position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Head of Lifecycle Marketing. The Marketing team is the engine that powers Remote's expansion. Through product marketing, performance marketing, events, communications, campaigns, and content, we tell the world about Remote to bring in revenue and establish Remote as the international leader in global HR and remote work.

You’ll design and own the strategies that drive engagement, retention, and long-term customer value. This role is both strategic and hands-on — building a high-performing team while innovating across the customer journey to maximize impact.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, with success at scale in fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in building and scaling customer lifecycle programs across multiple channels.
  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of leveraging data to inform strategy and execution.
  • Experience managing and scaling high-performing teams with a focus on ownership and accountability.
  • Deep understanding of customer segmentation, messaging, and personalization at scale.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a balance of creative vision and operational rigor.
  • Passion for innovation and elevating the digital customer experience.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • It\'s not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategy, from onboarding to retention, upsell, and advocacy.
  • Lead and mentor a team of lifecycle and CRM marketers, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Design and optimize multi-channel lifecycle programs (email, in-app, push, SMS, communities, etc.) that drive measurable impact.
  • Partner with Product, Data, and Growth to deliver personalized, customer-centric experiences.
  • Develop segmentation and targeting strategies to increase engagement, reduce churn, and grow LTV.
  • Establish KPIs and ensure continuous testing, measurement, and iteration of lifecycle initiatives.
  • Champion automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making across the lifecycle function.

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Bar Raiser Interview
  5. Prior employment verification check

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $179,300 — $302,600 USD.

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

  • Instalação de medidores de gás natural ou GLP.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • Troubleshoot, use the terminal, and make macOS work in the enterprise.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The Position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a VP, Growth Marketing.

In this role, you will own the data-driven marketing strategy to grow our top-of-funnel and increase marketing’s contribution to revenue.

You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with GTM, Product, Data, and other teams to turn growth into a durable, compounding engine for the business.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record driving growth strategy in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
  • Deep expertise in performance marketing, lifecycle, web strategy, and product-led growth, with a strong analytical foundation.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and comfort owning outcomes.
  • Experience leading innovation — building new playbooks, not just running existing ones.
  • Ability to attract, grow, and retain top talent while fostering intensity and accountability.
  • Strategic thinker who can zoom out to vision and zoom in to flawless execution.
  • It is not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end growth marketing strategy to grow top-of-funnel pipeline and accelerate closed-won revenue.
  • Build and manage a high-performing Growth Marketing team, agencies, and vendors, setting high performance standards and fostering a culture of innovation and operational excellence.
  • Lead full-funnel growth initiatives with an emphasis on top-of-funnel expansion across paid, organic, ABM, and emerging channels.
  • Define, track, and report on core growth metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, conversion, incremental lift), translating data insights into actions that improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Architect and refine attribution methods (MMM, MTA, experimentation frameworks) to measure channel effectiveness and optimize spend.
  • Develop and execute a continuous experimentation plan to uncover and scale new growth levers for customer acquisition.
  • Drive B2B strategies including vertical messaging and persona-based tactics to increase lead quality and accelerate pipeline velocity.
  • Partner with different teams, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, and Data, to ensure a cohesive GTM strategy and a seamless customer journey that maximizes revenue outcomes.

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote\'s Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $210,250- $315,350. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

Application process

  2. Interview with CEO
  3. Interview with President
  4. Interview with Chief People Officer
  5. Bar Raiser Interview
  6. Prior employment verification check

#LI-DNP

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

Responsibilities

International Trade Coordination

  • Supervise all import and export processes, including documentation management, customs clearance, and compliance with trade regulations
  • Coordinate with customs brokers, international carriers, and customs authorities
  • Ensure proper application of Incoterms, tariff classifications, permits, and non-tariff regulations

3PL Warehouse Management

  • Oversee operations with third-party logistics providers, including receiving, storage, inventory control, and outbound dispatches

  • Monitor inventory accuracy and seamless data exchange between internal systems and 3PL warehouse management systems (WMS)

Domestic Distribution Planning

  • Organize and supervise national distribution, including route planning and delivery schedules
  • Coordinate with carriers and logistics partners to ensure on-time and complete deliveries (OTD)

Cost and Process Optimization

Operational Monitoring and Control

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Strong analytical skills and experience with logistics cost analysis and KPI management
  • Operational leadership and strategic planning abilities
  • Problem-solving in logistics and supply chain environments
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills
  • Adaptability and stress management in dynamic contexts

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are a remote-first company with a global team and a culture driven by integrity, accountability, and progress.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users who need assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.
  • Support end users via channels such as Slack and Jira; own the first line of support.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding of employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, tools and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on identity providers and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects with agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across media; clear, concise, and culturally sensitive communication.
  • Proficiency in documentation, tickets, emails, and Slack communications.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. A builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and the ability to operate in ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment are highly valued. We value collaboration, empathy, and impact across functions and cultures.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role with opportunities for growth in a global digital asset company.

About Our Environment & Application Process

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first culture. Due to high volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

EEO & Contact

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process at the designated email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Employment type: Full-time

Overview

Estamos em busca de um(a) Pentester Pleno para atuar em projetos de segurança ofensiva, com foco em testes de penetração em infraestrutura, aplicações web, APIs e mobile (Android/iOS).

Responsibilities

  • Condução de testes em infraestrutura, web, APIs e aplicativos mobile (Android e iOS), identificando falhas de segurança em código e configuração.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática em pentests de infraestrutura, web, APIs e mobile (Android/iOS).
  • Vivência em diferentes abordagens de pentest (black-box, gray-box e white-box).
  • Familiaridade com análise de código e revisão de segurança em Python, JavaScript, Java, e PHP.
  • Boa compreensão de redes e protocolos (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, etc.).
  • Experiência na elaboração de relatórios técnicos claros e objetivos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias e frameworks de pentest (OWASP Top 10, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK, etc.).
  • Disposição para aprendizado contínuo e evolução na área de segurança ofensiva.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações como CompTIA: Security+, CySA+, Pentest+, EC-Council: CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), e outras como eJPT, DCPT, CNPen ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes de segurança (Python/Bash).
  • Experiência em segurança em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Vivência com ferramentas de SAST e DAST.
  • Inglês avançado.

  • Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data-driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills.   • Recognition rewards

  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services
  • Excellent communication skills (in either French or English).

  • Experience working with a development provider a plus
  • Proven track record of prioritization of own work
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Attention to detail

ACKNOWLEDGING THE POWER OF DIVERSITY

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs, and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead!

For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

WELCOME TO BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt, and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia, and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 16,000 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey.

description:
Overview

Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 7 .400 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1.000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você resides na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Você atuará junto ao time global nas entregas da Controladoria (Fechamento Mensal, Forecast, Budget e acompanhamento de KPIs, com foco na elaboração de reports gerenciais).

Será responsável por garantir a integridade e clareza das informações financeiras, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões.

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar relatórios financeiros detalhados, assegurando a precisão e relevância dos dados apresentados;
  • Realizar análises de flutuação financeira, Variação Cambial e de Resultado entre períodos, alinhando-se às particularidades do negócio e sazonalidades, para apoiar a tomada de decisões;
  • Acompanhar detalhadamente todas as linhas do P&L, identificando variações e insights relevantes;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de fechamento mensal e da elaboração do Budget anual e Forecast mensal;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos da área de forma contínua, promovendo a integração com outras equipes para automação e ganho de produtividade;
  • Estruturar e atuar em processos de PDCA;
  • Atender as demandas da área de Relações com Investidores, Controles Internos e auditorias internas e externas;
  • Facilitar a troca de experiências e aplicação de boas práticas dentro do time e com outros times e realizar a difusão das regras de negócio através de comunicação assertiva sobre as diretrizes da CI&T.

Requisitos mandatórios :

  • Experiência de 5 anos com todo o P&L e Análises de flutuação;
  • Experiência em análise, planejamento e controle, considerando o P&L integral;
  • Experiência com processo de Fechamento Mensal, Forecast e Budget;
  • Experiência com reporting e demonstrações de resultado;
  • Experiência em fechamento contábil mensal e elaboração de relatórios financeiros detalhados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados (preferencialmente o Power BI)
  • Experiência em trabalho no âmbito global (entidades no exterior);
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação
  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Habilidade de negociação e mobilização para ações efetivas;
  • Tiver paixão por novos aprendizados e desafios;
  • Já tiver atuado com Lean e Métodos Ágeis;
  • Possuir um mindset voltado para a melhoria contínua e eficiência de processos;
  • Possuir experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA.

Benefícios :

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale alimentação e refeição;
  • Licença parental estendida;
  • Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem-estar via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);
  • Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar;
  • Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;

Na CI&T, a inclusão começa no primeiro contato. Se você é pessoa com deficiência, é importante apresentar o seu laudo durante o processo seletivo. Assim, podemos garantir o suporte e as adaptações que você merece. Se ainda não tem o laudo caracterizador, não se preocupe: podemos te apoiar para obtê-lo.

Temos um time dedicado de Saúde e Bem-estar, especialistas em inclusão e grupos de afinidade que estarão com você em todas as etapas. Conte com a gente para fazer essa jornada lado a lado.

description:
Better Now |São Paulo - SP | Remoto

Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um Analista Funcional para atuar em projetos de mapeamento de processos e apoio à transformação digital, com foco em soluções voltadas para canais de atendimento. O profissional será responsável por entender as necessidades das áreas de negócio, modelar processos e apoiar a implementação de soluções tecnológicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Levantar e documentar os processos atuais dos sistemas de atendimento (AS IS), incluindo canais como CRM e possivelmente telefone, chat e e-mail;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e workshops com stakeholders das áreas de negócio;
  • Modelar os processos futuros (TO BE) em conjunto com as áreas demandantes, alinhando com as diretrizes da nova solução Salesforce;
  • Produzir documentos funcionais, fluxogramas e apresentações executivas para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o desenvolvimento da solução;
  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e a equipe técnica, garantindo o entendimento e a rastreabilidade dos requisitos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Analista Funcional em projetos de mapeamento de processos e transformação digital;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos (ex: BPMN) e ferramentas como Visio, Bizagi, Lucidchart ou similares;
  • Vivência com sistemas de atendimento multicanal (telefone, chat, e-mail, CRM);
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e relacionamento com áreas diversas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com projetos envolvendo Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Certificações em análise de negócios (CBAP, PMI-PBA) são um diferencial.
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição (Swile): R$ 660,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Home Office: R$ 100,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Creche (conforme acordo coletivo);
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica Clássico (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Auxílio Educação Alura (mensalidade paga 100% pela empresa);
  • Parceria com escolas de inglês e faculdades;
  • Total Pass: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Wellhub: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Acesso ao Sesc São Paulo.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a BetterNow, uma consultoria em qualidade de software que valoriza relações próximas, processos simples e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Nosso propósito é criar soluções que realmente façam a diferença, com foco na excelência, na transparência e na entrega de valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma cultura aberta, que valoriza a troca de ideias, o aprendizado contínuo e a autonomia. Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis, buscamos inovação e acreditamos que, mais do que processos, são as pessoas que garantem a qualidade em cada entrega. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidade de crescer junto, a BetterNow é o seu lugar!

description:
Gerente de Categoria de Compras

Local: Campinas/SP

Descrição da função

Como parte da equipe de compras da Medley, o gerente conduz a estratégia de categoria, a implementação de sourcing estratégico e a excelência operacional, em conformidade com os procedimentos e melhores práticas corporativas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciamento de Categorias e Implantação de Sourcing Estratégico
  • Conduzir o desenvolvimento do Gerenciamento de Categorias para a categoria responsável (principalmente materiais diretos; experiência em materiais indiretos será apreciada).
  • Desenvolver práticas de inteligência de mercado (dinâmicas e tendências) e avaliar e analisar continuamente o mercado fornecedor.
  • Capturar a inovação da categoria antecipadamente e avaliar o potencial no ambiente Medley com o apoio das partes interessadas relevantes.
  • Implemente efetivamente estratégias de sourcing para todos os gastos de subcategorias.
  • Parceria de negócios
  • Desenvolver parcerias de negócios robustas e conduza o gerenciamento das partes interessadas para atender às necessidades de negócios de forma adequada.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos sólidos de engajamento de negócios.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Fornecedor e Gestão do Relacionamento com o Fornecedor
  • Desenvolver uma matriz de recursos do fornecedor para identificar os negócios e os recursos dos fornecedores existentes e novos.
  • Segmente os fornecedores em grupos distintos e defina estratégias de fornecedores relevantes.
  • Gerenciar o processo de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores com os principais parceiros estratégicos para o âmbito local.
  • Estabeleça planos de mitigação de riscos quando necessário.
  • Atividades operacionais
  • Gerenciar atividades de compras de categoria regional e local, incluindo gerenciamento de demanda e experiência de compra.
  • Gestão de Demanda
  • Elaboração de um plano de demanda alinhado com o negócio e a estratégia da categoria
  • Construir um projeto sólido e um pipeline de economia durante o ciclo orçamentário e mantê-lo ao longo do ano
  • Desafiar construtivamente a demanda e moldá-la para agregar o máximo valor aos negócios.
  • Source-to-Pay (experiência de compra)
  • Projetar e executar um processo de licitação competitivo para a categoria, buscando as melhores soluções de valor agregado dos fornecedores.
  • Avaliar as ofertas competitivas dos fornecedores e desenvolver estratégias de negociação que atendam aos requisitos de negócios.
  • Realizar uma análise de custos aprofundada para desenvolver iniciativas de economia direcionadas por meio de várias frentes de redução de custos.
  • Parceria com as equipes jurídica, de conformidade e finanças para a conclusão bem-sucedida de negociações complexas.
  • Oferecer economia e redução de custos e rastreá-las em um sistema de relatórios para garantir que as economias negociadas sejam transformadas em economias realizadas e reais.
  • Melhorar a gestão de caixa e o índice de capital de giro.
  • Promover a cultura de ética e integridade nos negócios na equipe, assegurando o adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da empresa e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da empresa em relação à equipe gerenciada, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária, com o objetivo de prevenir acidentes, reduzir riscos à saúde e impactos ambientais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão para assegurar tratamento igual aos colaboradores e parceiros.

Sobre você

  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing capaz de desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado de liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas; forte compreensão de contratos legais; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais; experiência em gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças; pós-graduação (preferencialmente nas mesmas áreas).
  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.

Por que escolher a Medley?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros, com reconhecimento pela eficácia na produção de genéricos, seguindo critérios de qualidade e rigor científico.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. A Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o progresso. Descubra o extraordinário. A Sanofi oferece oportunidades iguais a todos, sem discriminação de raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

Veja informações sobre Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão e ações da empresa. Esta posição pode exigir cumprimento de políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) e vacinação conforme políticas da empresa.

  • Realizar estimativas de custos.

title: Especialista de Infraestrutura
description:
Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves

As a Sourcing Director at JLL, you will lead strategic procurement initiatives that drive exceptional value for our clients and organization. In this senior role, you\'ll shape innovative sourcing strategies while building high-performing supplier relationships that support our global real estate services. You\'ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, negotiate complex agreements, and implement solutions that strengthen our market position. This position empowers you to thrive as a strategic leader, making impactful decisions that contribute to JLL\'s continued success while advancing your career in a culture that embraces innovative ways of working and values collaboration across our global network.

What your day-to-day will look like

  • Develop and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies for key service categories and supplier partnerships
  • Lead complex negotiations with strategic suppliers to secure optimal terms, pricing, and service levels
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple business units to identify procurement opportunities and requirements
  • Manage supplier relationship programs, including performance monitoring, risk assessment, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Analyze market trends and supplier capabilities to inform strategic sourcing decisions and recommendations
  • Present sourcing strategies and outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or related field
  • 10+ years of progressive sourcing and procurement experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
  • Proven track record of managing complex, high-value sourcing initiatives and supplier relationships
  • Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated ability to secure favorable terms and agreements
  • Experience with procurement technologies, data analysis, and market intelligence tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

  • 5+ years of Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) experience
  • Experience in real estate, facilities management, or professional services industries
  • Global sourcing experience with understanding of international markets and regulations
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving organizational change initiatives
  • Knowledge of sustainability and ESG principles in procurement practices

Compensation and location

The salary listed is an estimate and not guaranteed. A salary offer will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, internal equity and alignment with market data

Location: REMOTE based in the United States

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location: Remote – Columbus, OH

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We\'re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

Overview

IgniteTech is transforming B2B enterprise software with a GenAI-first approach. We are seeking a proven AI product strategist to revolutionize our diverse portfolio and drive customer retention through cutting-edge AI integration. Working directly with the CEO, you will architect our GenAI strategy across 30+ products, identify high-value opportunities, and execute transformative roadmaps that position IgniteTech at the vanguard of enterprise AI adoption. This is not a theoretical position—we require demonstrated success in bringing AI products to market and scaling them. Your strategic vision will directly impact business outcomes in a company committed to excellence and positioned to lead the GenAI revolution.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop comprehensive AI Opportunity Matrices that rank customer problems by AI feasibility, business value, and risk—guiding go/no-go decisions and development prioritization
  • Architect progressive AI-Enhanced Product Roadmaps that transform current offerings into AI-powered solutions, with clear dependencies, success metrics, and balanced timelines
  • Create precise AI Feature Requirements translating advanced capabilities into actionable user stories with acceptance criteria, performance benchmarks, and robust fallback protocols
  • Execute Customer AI Readiness Assessments to identify adoption barriers across segments and deliver targeted enablement plans

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Navigating bureaucratic approval processes that impede innovation—we maintain a streamlined decision-making structure that empowers your expertise
  • Developing AI features in isolation—your work will be directly informed by customer needs and aligned with strategic business objectives
  • Managing theoretical AI projects—every initiative you lead will be targeted for production deployment with measurable business impact
  • Operating with limited resources—IgniteTech is committed to providing the necessary support for successful AI transformation across our portfolio

Chief AI Officer Key Responsibilities

Drive measurable business growth by strategically integrating Generative AI functionalities across IgniteTech’s entire product portfolio, directly impacting customer engagement, retention, and competitive advantage in the enterprise software market.

Basic Requirements

  • Proven track record of launching at least 2 production-grade AI/ML-powered products or major features (prototypes or experiments are not sufficient)
  • Demonstrated expertise managing the complete product lifecycle for AI-enabled solutions, from concept through development to scaled deployment and optimization
  • Experience directing data science and ML engineering teams from a product leadership position, translating technical capabilities into business value

World-class talent. 100% global remote. We’re a leading provider of enterprise software solutions with a remote-work-from-anywhere culture that enables hiring the best from around the world.

Ready to be part of the top talent IgniteTech has curated? We invite you to join us.
